settings.measurement: Confirmed current CFAR local maxima only; native bins; no held or predicted distance
settings.input: Full RD power; zero Doppler retained; no empty/background subtraction
settings.nominal_distance: Native RD bin centers retained beside experimental uncalibrated refinements
settings.identity: Radar feature hypotheses, not certified object identities or obstacle decisions
settings.freshness: Live stream continuity, host clock, backlog and timeout gates clear all hypotheses
settings.primary_policy: Exact frozen 1D baseline; no automatic RD-only promotion
settings.refinement: Current dense range FFT then slow-time Hann FFT; three Doppler rows; native half-bin range support; competing nearby peaks withheld
settings.evidence: 1D and RD share ADC data; source agreement is not independent confirmation
settings.motion_policy: v2: two consecutive same-sign confirmed RD motion measurements; stopped continuation requires current CA threshold and local-peak support; no held/predicted range

interpretation: Development regression; no independent physical accuracy acceptance. Every primary exactly reproduces the frozen 1D distance, every RD mask and association matches the standalone algorithms. RD-only refinements are inspection values, not target identities or automatic primary measurements. Saved host freshness is not re-certified.
